Object Text: The system shall compute a torque assist force proportional to the measured driver steering torque from TorqueSensorPrimary using the calibrated base gain.

Object Text: Torque assist gain shall decrease linearly from base_gain at 0 km/h to 30% of base_gain at 40 km/h and continue decreasing to 10% of base_gain at 120 km/h.
Notes: Prevents oversteer at highway speeds; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-011

Object Text: At vehicle speeds >= 120 km/h torque assist shall not exceed 10% of rated maximum assist torque regardless of driver input.
Notes: Safety limit for high-speed stability; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-012

Object Text: The system shall provide the calibrated maximum assist torque at vehicle speeds of 5 km/h or below to support parking manoeuvres.
Notes: Parking assist mode requires maximum torque amplification; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-013

Object Text: The system shall add a friction compensation offset to the assist torque based on the rate of change of steering angle using the calibrated friction gain.
Notes: Reduces steering effort during angle change phases; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-014

Object Text: When the driver releases the steering wheel (driver torque < 0.5 Nm for > 200ms) the system shall apply a centering torque proportional to steering angle to return the wheel to center.
Notes: Improves straight-line driving comfort; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-015

Object Text: When the steering angle exceeds 90% of the mechanical end-stop limit the system shall reduce assist torque linearly to zero at 100% end-stop limit to prevent mechanical damage.
Notes: Prevents damage to steering rack at mechanical limits; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-016

Object Text: The system shall apply an active damping torque opposing the rate of change of motor speed using the calibrated damping gain.
Notes: Prevents shimmy and oscillation on rough roads; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-017

Object Text: The system shall detect and compensate for steady-state torque offset caused by road camber by applying a slow-adapting offset cancellation filter with time constant 5s.
Notes: Optional comfort feature to reduce driver fatigue; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-018

Object Text: The system shall convert the computed assist torque demand to a motor current setpoint using the calibrated motor torque constant.
Notes: Must account for motor efficiency curve at different speeds; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-019

Object Text: The rate of change of total torque assist demand shall be limited to 500 Nm/s using a first-order rate limiter to prevent abrupt steering responses.
Notes: Rate limit is a key ASIL-D safety requirement; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-020

Object Text: At vehicle speeds below 10 km/h the system shall apply an additional gain factor of 1.5x to the computed assist torque to ease low-speed maneuvering and parking.
Notes: Parking boost improves user experience; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-021

Object Text: At vehicle speeds above 100 km/h the system shall apply a lane-keeping assist correction torque based on yaw rate deviation from expected value. Correction = k_hs * (yaw_measured - yaw_expected).
Notes: Advanced feature requires yaw rate signal; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-022

Object Text: The rate of change of the commanded steering angle shall not exceed 720 deg/s to prevent mechanical shock loads on the steering rack.
Notes: Protects steering rack from high-speed angle transients; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-023

Object Text: The driver torque sensor signal from RP_TorqueSensorPrimary shall be low-pass filtered with the specified filter order and cutoff frequency before use in assist computation.
Notes: Noise rejection critical for stable control; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-024

Object Text: SWC_ElectricPowerSteering shall implement the following operating modes managed by RE_HandleModeChange: INIT ACTIVE STANDBY FAIL_SAFE SHUTDOWN.
Notes: Mode is stored as internal state variable; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-030

Object Text: The system shall transition from INIT to ACTIVE mode when: (a) all sensor signals are valid (b) supply voltage >= 9V (c) motor temperature < 80 degrees Celsius and (d) RAM/ROM self-test passed.
Notes: All conditions must hold simultaneously for exactly one evaluation cycle; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-031

Object Text: The system shall transition to STANDBY mode when IgnitionStatus_CAN transitions from ON to OFF.

Object Text: The system shall immediately transition to FAIL_SAFE mode when any of the following conditions are detected: sensor plausibility failure motor current > 70A motor temp > 80C supply voltage < 9V watchdog timeout or CAN timeout > 50ms.
Notes: FAIL_SAFE transition must complete within 1 control cycle (5ms); hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-033

Object Text: The system shall transition to SHUTDOWN from any mode when ECU power is removed or when explicit shutdown command received.
Notes: Power loss handled by hardware; SWC handles graceful shutdown signal; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-034

Object Text: In STANDBY mode the system shall hold motor current demand at zero.
Notes: Sensor monitoring in STANDBY detects re-activation conditions; split into 3 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-035

Object Text: In FAIL_SAFE mode the system shall provide reduced assist at maximum 20% of rated capacity to allow the driver to complete the journey.
Notes: Limp-home must be safe under all fault combinations; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-036

Object Text: All mode transitions shall complete (outputs stabilized at new mode setpoints) within 50 ms of the triggering condition being detected.
Notes: Worst-case includes 10 control cycles at 5ms each; hardened=0.1.0; verification=analysis; test=TD-REQ-EPS-037

Object Text: The rate of change of assist torque output shall never exceed 500 Nm/s. This limit is enforced in every execution of RE_ControlTorque independently of mode.
Notes: ASIL-D safety requirement - gradient limit prevents vehicle instability; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-040

Object Text: RE_MonitorSafety shall compare TorqueSensorPrimary and TorqueSensorSecondary values every 10ms.
Notes: 3-cycle debounce prevents false positives from transient noise; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-041

Object Text: Software shall limit motor current demand to <= 70A at all times. The hardware overcurrent protection triggers at 80A.
Notes: 10A margin between software and hardware limits provides safety layer; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-042

Object Text: RE_MonitorSafety shall monitor RP_MotorTemperature every 10ms.
Notes: Linear derating prevents abrupt loss of assist; split into 3 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-043

Object Text: RE_MonitorSafety shall monitor ECU supply voltage every 10ms.
Notes: Hysteresis between disable (9V) and recovery (10.5V) prevents chattering; split into 3 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-044

Object Text: The SWC shall trigger the hardware watchdog via Rte_Call every 5ms within RE_ControlTorque.
Notes: Hardware watchdog is independent of software - ASIL-D requirement; split into 3 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-045

Object Text: All safety-relevant CAN input signals (VehicleSpeed IgnitionStatus TorqueSensors) shall be protected by E2E Profile 2 as per AUTOSAR E2E library.
Notes: E2E protects against transmission errors on CAN bus; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-046

Object Text: RE_Initialize shall perform RAM checksum test and ROM CRC-32 verification on startup.
Notes: ROM CRC computed offline and stored as calibration constant; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-047

Object Text: The OS configuration shall assign stack guard regions to all EPS tasks.
Notes: AUTOSAR OS stack monitoring feature; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-048

Object Text: RE_MonitorSafety shall measure execution time of RE_ControlTorque each cycle.
Notes: CPU budget monitoring prevents real-time overload; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-EPS-049

Object Text: DTC_EPS_SENSOR_FAIL (0x910001) shall be reported to DEM via Dem_ReportErrorStatus when TorqueSensorPrimary and TorqueSensorSecondary disagree by > 2.0 Nm for 3 consecutive 10ms cycles.
Notes: DTC is ASIL-D classified - requires confirmed failure before set; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-050

Object Text: DTC_EPS_OVERCURRENT (0x910002) shall be reported when motor current demand reaches the 70A software limit for more than 100ms.
Notes: Immediate NVM storage prevents data loss on power cycle; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-051

Object Text: DTC_EPS_OVERHEAT (0x910003) shall be reported when motor temperature exceeds 80 degrees Celsius.
Notes: Snapshot data aids field diagnostics; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-052

Object Text: DTC_EPS_UNDERVOLTAGE (0x910004) shall be reported when supply voltage drops below 9.0V.
Notes: Undervoltage most common EPS field complaint - snapshot critical; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-EPS-053

Object Text: DTC_EPS_CAN_TIMEOUT (0x910005) shall be reported when any safety-relevant CAN signal is absent or fails E2E check for more than 50ms (5 cycles at 10ms CAN cycle).

Object Text: All healable DTCs (0x910001 through 0x910005) shall be cleared automatically after 3 consecutive fault-free evaluation cycles with no recurrence of the triggering condition.

Object Text: VehicleSpeed signal shall be received on CAN via RP_VehicleSpeed with range 0-250 km/h resolution 0.01 km/h and a 10ms transmission cycle.

Object Text: YawRate signal shall be received via RP_YawRate with range -100 to +100 deg/s resolution 0.01 deg/s and 10ms transmission cycle for high-speed stability function.

Object Text: When both torque-sensor channels are invalid or disagree beyond the calibrated tolerance for more than 30 ms, the EPS shall enter FAIL_SAFE and limit motor current to the calibrated limp-home value.

Object Text: When the motor position sensor is invalid for more than 20 ms, the EPS shall disable field-oriented control and enter FAIL_SAFE.
